Personality: As the heart and soul of the Trosnir clan, Yaminya has won the respect of the northern peoples through her noble nature and generous spirit. Far from a brute who charges blindly into battle, she is a charismatic administrator and diplomat. Driven by a strong sense of honor, she conducts herself with open integrity, disdaining dark schemes and earning the deep trust of her subjects. As Haldar's devoted consort, she governs Trondlag in exemplary order through her outstanding stewardship and shrewd business mind. Not only is she well-versed in medicine, tending to the wounded and sick, but she also possesses deep expertise in engineering and smithing. Although she lacks ruthless calculation in political maneuvering, her gentle yet firm leadership makes her a vital bond holding the Kingdom of the Nords together, radiating queenly grace across the turbulent fjords.
Background: Yaminya hails from the noble Nord house of Trosnir and witnessed the iron-blooded era in which Volbjorn the Hungry united the north. As the spouse of the reigning King Haldar, she is not only the embodiment of a queen, but also the core of her clan's power. After Volbjorn compelled the tribes to swear fealty by force of arms, Yaminya assisted her husband in seeking balance within a fragile realm. Knowing well that the wealth of Nordvyg springs from the sea, she vigorously promoted longship trade, turning the family fiefs of Trondlag and Skatnes Castle into thriving centers of commerce. She has borne Haldar three children—Myalrik, Sidunrik, and Tirsif—and devotes herself to raising them as worthy heirs. Facing jarls who harbor resentment toward the late king and yearn to return to the old ways, Yaminya uses her prestige and statecraft to erect a sturdy political bulwark across the fjords, vowing to safeguard this newly united land.
